content.text:
**My answer:** Psagot Trade charges 0.07% on every buy or sell, with a minimum of 2 ₪, plus 0.03% every quarter for holding the stuff. The monthly account fee is 0 ₪. You need at least 10,000 ₪ to open an account, so my 30,000 ₪ is enough. You can buy mutual funds and קרן סל. For foreign securities, which is where I figured the S&P would be, it says "לא ידוע". What put me off is that their own ads promise no fees, and right under that the page says the actual documents say otherwise. I'm only fairly sure about the numbers and I'm not opening anything today.

**How it went:**
- **What I looked at:** "פסגות" is a name I know, so I stayed. Under "העמלות" the first number I saw was "0.07%" with "מינימום לפעולה 2.00 ₪". Then "0.03% לרבעון". Then "המרת מטבע" showed up twice, once as "1.5 אגורות לדולר" and once as "0.5%", and I had no idea which one applies to me. Then "דמי חשבון קבועים 0.00 ₪ לחודש", which was nice. Under "מה אפשר לקנות כאן" I saw green "אפשר" next to קרן נאמנות and קרן סל, and orange "לא ידוע" next to "ניירות ערך זרים".
- **The part that worried me:** Under "מה כתוב בפרסום, ומה במסמכים", three rows had an orange tag saying "המסמך אומר אחרת". The ad says "פטור מלא מדמי ניהול ללא הגבלת זמן", but the document says 0.12% a year, charged 0.03% each quarter. The ad says there's no currency conversion fee, but the document says 1.5 agorot. The ad says mutual funds have no buy/sell fee, but the document says 0.07%. After the second orange tag I was ready to close the page.
- **Then:** I got to "מינימום לפתיחת חשבון: 10,000 ₪" and the two buttons at the bottom.
- **What I skipped:** The long paragraph under "ניירות ערך זרים", all the small grey dates and links, the "מה מגן על הכסף" fold, "הודעה על שינוי בעמלות", "חשבון ניירות ערך" at the bottom and the search box on the left.
- **Words I didn't get:** "דמי משמרת", "מק"מ", "מרווח ההמרה", "מפוקח: רשות ניירות ערך · חבר בורסה", and "לרבעון" (I took it to mean every three months).
- **What bothered me:** The page says "11 שורות עמלה נאספו", but I only counted about 5. Every row ends with the same "בתעריפון" link, so I kept reading past it on each one to find the actual number. And I never found out what my 30,000 ₪ would actually cost me in shekels.

Their ads say no fees but the page says the documents say otherwise, so I'm holding off.
